business_problem: Qonto wanted small-business customers to stop spending up to eight hours a month on repetitive financial admin such as transfers, invoicing, payroll, and cash-flow questions, but any agent touching bank accounts had to satisfy compliance, latency, and accuracy constraints.
solution_summary: Qonto's AI Lab built in-app agents on the Claude Platform to act as both operators and analysts inside business banking workflows. Users upload invoices or payroll documents and chat with the agent instead of navigating the product manually. Complex steps run on Claude Opus 4.5 and Sonnet, while smaller steps go to Haiku, all through Amazon Bedrock so Qonto can use structured outputs, prompt caching, quota controls, and provider-level GDPR and EU AI Act compliance. The operator agent prepares transfers, drafts invoices, and converts payroll runs into bulk payments but always pauses for final customer approval before money moves. On the analysis side, agents answer questions over transaction data so customers can understand cash flow without exporting numbers into spreadsheets. Internally, Qonto's builders use Claude Code, Claude Cowork, and Claude Design to ship and refine the experience quickly.

solution_components.name: Claude Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the model platform behind Qonto's in-app operator and analyst agents.

solution_components.name: Claude Opus 4.5
solution_components.role: Runs the most complex agent missions around financial administration and insight generation.

solution_components.name: Claude Sonnet
solution_components.role: Handles many of the production financial-admin steps alongside Opus.

solution_components.name: Claude Haiku
solution_components.role: Covers simpler, latency-sensitive steps in Qonto's routed workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Supplies the controlled runtime and provider-level compliance envelope for Claude inside Qonto.

data_flow: Customers upload invoices, payslips, or ask a question in the Qonto app, the workflow routes each step to the right Claude model tier, the agent prepares transfers, invoice drafts, or payroll actions, and the customer gives the final approval before money or documents are sent.
integration_points: customer CRM or spreadsheet source lists
business_outcome: Qonto made bank transfers 2x faster, cut invoice creation time 3x, sped payroll runs 5x, and saw customers trust agents with transfers as large as €100,000 while preserving final human approval for every action.
